contract.goal: One synthesis of the supplied documents, organized by idea rather than by document, that answers the synthesis question, surfaces contradictions and open questions, and cites the document behind every point.

deliverables.description: The synthesis: a short answer up front, one section per theme, an open questions and contradictions section, and a Sources key that maps each [n] to its document

criteria.text: The synthesis is a full document organized under several section headings
It has a section on the open questions and contradictions across the documents

checks.label: an open questions or contradictions section

criteria.text: It ends with a Sources section that maps each [n] to the path of the document it stands for
Its points cite at least two documents, and every cited file exists
Every number, date and quote appears in the document it cites; nothing checkable is asserted that the documents do not show
Every document in the corpus was read and is cited somewhere in the synthesis

judge.rubric: Does the synthesis draw on and cite every document in the corpus, rather than leaning on the first few?

criteria.text: It opens with a one-paragraph answer and weaves the documents together by theme, rather than summarizing each file in turn

judge.rubric: Does the synthesis open with a direct answer and organize its body by idea across documents, rather than as a file-by-file summary?
